use_case: AI-assisted alert triage in the SIEM: scores alerts, writes plain-language summaries, auto-closes low-scoring alerts, and flags unusual user behavior
vendor_or_model: SIEM vendor feature (machine learning scoring plus a generative summary model)
data_categories: Security logs from the identity provider, cloud tenant, and endpoints: workforce and customer user IDs, IP addresses, device names, tenant metadata
affects_individuals: Yes (employees through user-behavior alerts; customers indirectly if attacks are missed)
consequential_decision_category: Safety/CI (security monitoring of hosting that serves 14 banks); escalates to Employment if alerts are used in discipline
human_in_the_loop: Analysts review High and Critical alerts; low-scoring alerts auto-close with no review (gap). Conditions in the assessment add review before closing privileged and RMM alerts and a weekly sample
applicable_laws: MSA confidentiality clause (SIEM vendor as subprocessor); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor accuracy and data-use claims); state AI employment laws only if outputs influence discipline where the employee works (for example IL HB 3773; CO SB26-189 from 2027-01-01); C-IT-R01 readiness (SI-4, AU-6)
status: In production since 2026-04; approved with conditions 2026-09-25

use_case: Generative AI coding assistant in the code editor for control plane and portal developers
vendor_or_model: Enterprise coding assistant (vendor-hosted large language model)
data_categories: Source code and pipeline definitions; no customer data
human_in_the_loop: All suggestions go through pull-request review (one approver; bypass being removed, POAM-017)
applicable_laws: Vendor terms (no training on company code, confirmed in the enterprise agreement); C-IT-R01 readiness (SA-11, SA-10)
status: Pilot with 4 engineers; wider rollout after static analysis is added to CI
